resumeText:
Arjun Nair | Kochi | arjun.nair@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Odoo Developer, Malabar ERP Labs, Kochi (2022 - present)
- Developed custom Odoo modules for inventory, purchase and manufacturing using the Odoo ORM.
- Configured Odoo Accounting and Inventory apps for 8 distribution clients, including GST taxes and warehouse routes.
- Designed QWeb reports for invoices, delivery slips and job cards.
- Wrote Python business logic and computed fields, and tuned slow PostgreSQL queries on large stock tables.
- Built XML-RPC and REST integrations between Odoo and a courier platform.
- Migrated client databases from Odoo 15 to Odoo 17 with custom module upgrades.

SKILLS
Python, Odoo, PostgreSQL, XML, JavaScript

EDUCATION
BTech Computer Science, Cochin University of Science and Technology, 2022
